name: SignalHire
summary: Professional profiles with emails and phones by LinkedIn URL, email or phone, people search by title, company and location, and company profiles.

api_key.description: A SignalHire API key (Other tools > Integrations & API). Sent in the apikey header.

notes: Billing is split: person lookups spend standard credits, without-contacts lookups and company profiles each spend their own credit type, and people search draws on a daily quota shared with the web app.
The default person lookup and the company employee-profile export deliver only to a callback URL, so they are not in this entry; person lookup is listed in its synchronous mode.
The Company API is off by default; SignalHire support enables it.

endpoints.name: Get remaining credits
endpoints.summary: Standard contact credits left, or without-contacts credits.

withoutContacts.description: true for the without-contacts credit balance instead of standard credits.

notes: Free. Every response also carries the balance in the X-Credits-Left header.

endpoints.name: Look up people and their contacts
endpoints.summary: Profiles with emails and phones for up to 100 LinkedIn URLs, emails, phones or SignalHire profile uids, answered in the same call.

items.description: Up to 100 identifiers, types may be mixed: LinkedIn profile URLs, emails, phone numbers, SignalHire uids.

withoutWaterfall.description: Must be true: answer synchronously from SignalHire's own data.

withoutContacts.description: true: profile data only, no emails or phones, charged to the separate without-contacts credits.

notes: A read over POST. One standard credit per profile found (shared with the web app and extension); withoutContacts uses its own credit type.
Only the synchronous mode is listed: it searches SignalHire's own data, so coverage is lower and contacts can be older than the callback-based waterfall, which is not in this entry.
Each result has item, status (success, failed, credits_are_over, duplicate_query) and candidate. Limits: 100 items per call, 600 items a minute on paid plans, 5 on trial.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: Brief profiles (no contacts) matching title, company, location, industry, seniority and other filters; returns the first batch and a scrollId.

currentTitle.description: Boolean query on the current job title.

currentPastTitle.description: Boolean query on current or past titles; wins over currentTitle.

currentCompany.description: Boolean query on the current company name.

currentPastCompany.description: Boolean query on current or past company names.

keywords.description: Boolean query over skills, description, education and other profile text.

location.description: A country, a US/Canadian state, or a city with context ('Berlin, Germany'); a JSON array for several. 422 if not recognized.
location.example: New York, New York, United States

latitude.description: Geo search centre latitude, with longitude; overrides location.

radius.description: Radius in km around a city or point, 10 to 160, default 10.

industry.description: One industry from SignalHire's allowed list.

industries.description: Several industries from the allowed list.

department.description: Departments, e.g. Sales, Marketing, Engineering / Development, Data & Analytics.

level.description: Seniority: Intern / Entry Level, Junior, Mid-Level, Senior, Lead, Head, VP, C-Level, Founder / Owner, Board / Advisory, Directors.

education.description: Boolean query over university, faculty and degree.

yearsOfCurrentExperienceFrom.description: Minimum years in the current role.

yearsOfCurrentExperienceTo.description: Maximum years in the current role.

excludeRevealed.description: Leave out profiles whose contacts you already fetched.

notes: A read over POST. Not billed in credits: each query and each profile returned counts against a daily search quota shared with the web app; 402 when it runs out.
At least one filter other than the exclude* flags is required. At most 3 search calls at once.
Page on with signalhire.people.search_scroll within 15 seconds; pass profile uids to signalhire.person.lookup for contacts.

endpoints.name: Get the next batch of a people search
endpoints.summary: The next batch of a people search, with a new scrollId.

scrollId.description: scrollId from the previous search or scroll response.

notes: A read over POST. The scrollId expires 15 seconds after it is issued: call immediately, and stop when a response has no scrollId.
Not a new query against the daily quota, but every profile returned counts against the daily profile quota.

endpoints.name: Resolve a company id
endpoints.summary: SignalHire company id, slug and name for an id or slug.
notes: Free. The Company API must be enabled for the account by SignalHire support, else 403.

endpoints.name: Get a company profile
endpoints.summary: Industry, description, founding year, website, headcount, specialities and office locations.
notes: One company data credit per success, a credit type bought separately from support; 402 when none are left. Needs Company API access.

endpoints.name: Count a company's profiles
endpoints.summary: How many current, past or all employee profiles SignalHire holds for a company.
